result:
I reviewed PR #613's actual diff (not just its self-report) and wrote the verdict to `review-verdict.json`.

**Verdict: reject** (tier2 — would need human sign-off even on approval)

The feature implementation itself is solid: the approval-flow schema/migration, `pms-time-service.ts` state machine (self-approval blocked, tenant-scoped), manager-role-gated routes, and the two new reports all check out correctly, and 2244/2244 tests pass locally with a clean `tsc`.

But I caught a real, live-verified discrepancy between the self-report and reality: running this repo's own `check-terminology-guardrail.mjs --diff-only` gate locally returns **exit 1** — this PR's own new comments (all dated `2026-07-28`) across 5 files were never registered in `ai-os/registry/terminology-guardrail-exemptions.yaml`, breaking the exact convention every prior task in this PROGRESS.md history followed. I confirmed this isn't a local sandbox artifact by checking `gh pr checks 613` directly — **Terminology Guardrail Check is red on the actual GitHub PR right now**, despite PROGRESS.md claiming "all pass." A second failing check (Metadata Index Coverage) turned out to be pre-existing and unrelated to this PR, so I noted it separately rather than holding it against this PR.

Given CI is genuinely red and the verification claims don't hold up, this isn't ready to pass to a human for merge — it needs a small mechanical fix (exemption entries) first.
